method: UI in Claude in Chrome, the test account, pt-BR. Self-reported run; no screenshots or request bodies were kept.
steps_run: CRM > Contatos > Listas, row menu of test list ID 3 (0 contacts) > Duplicar
Side panel titled 'Lista duplicada': field 'Nome da lista' prefilled 'Duplicado de <name>' (max 255), select 'Pasta de destino' (default 'Sua primeira pasta'). Name changed to ZZ_TEST_list_2_dup
Pressed the black button at the bottom of the panel (also labelled 'Lista duplicada'): toast 'Duplicar a lista... Pode levar alguns minutos.'
Reloaded after a few seconds: the table showed a new row ZZ_TEST_list_2_dup with ID 6 (ID 5 was not shown)
results: A new list exists with the chosen name and ID 6
The internal call seen in the page hook was a GET to contacts-api-v2 /lists/duplicate
limitations: The source list had no contacts, so whether the copy receives the contacts of the source was not tested
The skipped ID 5 was not investigated
test_data_left_in_account: list ID 6 ZZ_TEST_list_2_dup (also holds test contact ID 2 after a later action)
